import sys, json, random, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, formats, pipeline, ref
found=0
for i in range(200):
    rnd=random.Random(5000+i)
    req=gen.make_request(rnd, cap={'range':4096,'exact':8192})
    data=json.dumps(req).encode()
    parsed=formats.read_request(io.BytesIO(data))
    out=pipeline.execute(parsed)
    want=ref.solve(json.loads(data.decode()))
    assert json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True), ('MISMATCH',5000+i)
    segs=[d for d in out['decisions'] if d['reason']=='segment']
    kept=sum(sum(1 for c in cat['clusters'] if c['kept']) for cat in out['catalog'])
    if kept>0:
        found+=1
        if found<4:
            rel=req['releases'][0]; cat=out['catalog'][0]
            print('seed',5000+i,'kept',kept,'segs',len(segs),'decisions',len(out['decisions']))
            print('  width',rel['width'],'mode',rel['mode'],'prio',cat['priority'])
            print('  cluster0', json.dumps(cat['clusters'][0]) if cat['clusters'] else None)
            print('  train0', rel['train'][0])
            print('  decisions sample', json.dumps(out['decisions'][:3]))
print('cases with kept clusters:',found,'of 200')
